likelyCauses.text: Connection exhaustion due to increased connection concurrency from a deployment

investigationSteps.text: Check PostgreSQL logs and Docker compose configuration

suggestedRemediation.text: Restore container/network availability before changing connection limits

likelyCauses.text: Memory exhaustion and OOMKilled restarts due to increased container memory usage and heap pressure.

investigationSteps.text: Check container termination reasons, memory limits, and restart history to identify the cause.

suggestedRemediation.text: Pause a confirmed memory-heavy job, reduce its batch size, and roll back the triggering release.
